SELECT iad.cmdb_id as applicationId, iad.application_name as application, ucm.uar_id , ucm.uar_name , ucm.access_review_scope as accessReviewScope, CASE WHEN iad.data_ready_flag THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END as cycleDataFlag,
iad.online_flag, iad.online_time, iad.offline_time, iad.decommission_reason, ucm.app_uar_platform_status, ucm.uar_cycle_start_date as uarCycleStartMonth, ucm.uar_cycle_end_date as uarCycleEndMonth, iad.operator_date , iad.operator_name , ucm.confirmation_date, iad.modified_by, iad.modification_date, iad.uar_processor, iad.uar_processor_email, iad.app_status, iad.application_it_owner, iad.operation_owner, iad.operation_focal, iad.data_source, aal.access_link FROM its_application_data iad LEFT JOIN its_application_access_link aal ON iad.cmdb_id = aal.cmdb_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM uar_cycle_maintenance WHERE cmdb_id = iad.cmdb_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ucm ON TRUE
order by iad.cmdb_id desc

SELECT iad.cmdb_id as applicationId, iad.application_name as application, ucm.uar_id , ucm.uar_name , ucm.access_review_scope as accessReviewScope, iad.online_time, iad.offline_time, iad.decommission_reason, ucm.uar_cycle_start_date as uarCycleStartMonth, ucm.uar_cycle_end_date as uarCycleEndMonth, iad.operator_date , iad.operator_name , ucm.confirmation_date, iad.modified_by, iad.modification_date, iad.uar_processor as uarProcessorStr, iad.uar_processor_email, iad.app_status, iad.operation_owner, iad.operation_focal, aal.access_link,
CASE WHEN iad.data_ready_flag THEN '就绪' ELSE '未就绪' END as cycleDataFlag, CASE WHEN iad.online_flag THEN '已上线' ELSE '已下线' END as onlineFlagStr, CASE ucm.app_uar_platform_status WHEN null THEN '无' WHEN 'Active' THEN '启用' WHEN 'Inactive' THEN '停用' WHEN 'Completed' THEN '已完成' ELSE '' END as appUarPlatformStatus, CASE iad.data_source WHEN 'IMPORT' THEN '导入' WHEN 'SYNC' THEN '同步' ELSE '' END as data_source
CASE WHEN iad.data_ready_flag THEN 'Ready' ELSE 'Not Ready' END as cycleDataFlag, CASE WHEN iad.online_flag THEN 'Online' ELSE 'Offline' END as onlineFlagStr, CASE ucm.app_uar_platform_status WHEN null THEN 'Empty' WHEN 'Active' THEN 'Enabled' WHEN 'Inactive' THEN 'Disabled' WHEN 'Completed' THEN 'Completed' ELSE '' END as appUarPlatformStatus, iad.data_source
FROM its_application_data iad LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM uar_cycle_maintenance WHERE cmdb_id = iad.cmdb_id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ucm ON TRUE LEFT JOIN its_application_access_link aal ON iad.cmdb_id = aal.cmdb_id
order by iad.cmdb_id desc
